clinic.kiorex_listing.whenOff: Listings PAUSED on Kiorex; confirmed bookings honoured; booking link still works

clinic.commission_settlement.whenOff: New commission charges stop; invoices = subscription only; confirmed charges still settle

clinic.kiorly_pay_deposits.whenOff: No new deposit requirements or links; existing deposits refund/convert per policy

whatsapp_reminders.whenOff: Reminders stop; manual call list shown

clinic.whatsapp_inbound.whenOff: Replies no longer change appointments; routed to inbox

instapay.whenOff: Method hidden at cashier; cash and other methods remain

fawry.whenOff: Method hidden at cashier; cash and other methods remain

card_payments.whenOff: Method hidden at cashier; cash and other methods remain

clinic.ai_scribe.whenOff: Record button hidden; signed notes unaffected

clinic.whatsapp_ai_receptionist.whenOff: Inbound messages go to human inbox

clinic.record_share_patient_app.whenOff: No new shares; existing shares stay visible to the patient

clinic.lab_order_handoff.whenOff: Lab orders kept as records only

clinic.payers_tpa.whenOff: Contract prices kept; no new claims

clinic.specialty_templates.<code>.note: Pattern key: <code> is the specialty template code; physio template code `physio` is launch-locked until GPR2 (KX-05 §07)

clinic.referral_rewards.whenOff: No new codes; earned credits honoured

clinic.field_rep_onboarding.whenOff: Rep codes rejected at signup; earned commissions honoured

kiorex.marketplace.whenOff: Search shows clinic phone only; no new bookings; existing bookings honoured

kiorex.pay_deposits.whenOff: Deposit-required visit types bookable without deposit or hidden (per market setting)

kiorex.reviews.whenOff: No new reviews; aggregates still displayed

kiorex.family_accounts.whenOff: Existing dependants kept; cannot add new

kiorex.sponsored_listings.whenOff: Sponsored slots removed; organic ranking only

kiorex.pharmacy_orders.whenOff: Pharmacy tab hidden; open orders completed or refunded

kiorex.lab_bookings.whenOff: Lab tab hidden; booked collections honoured

pharmacy.module.whenOff: No new sign-ups; existing tenants read-only with export

pharmacy.kiorex_orders.whenOff: Order inbox hidden; stock not exposed

lab.module.whenOff: No new sign-ups; existing tenants read-only with export

market.<country>.live.whenOff: Country hidden from sign-up and search; existing tenants unaffected
market.<country>.live.note: Pattern key: <country> is a lower-case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, e.g. market.eg.live

clinic.profession.physiotherapy.whenOff: No new physio sign-ups; existing physios keep working
clinic.profession.physiotherapy.note: KX-05 §06-07; the physiotherapy pack template itself is gated by clinic.specialty_templates.physio (GPR2)

clinic.home_visits.whenOff: Home visit types hidden for new bookings; booked visits honoured
clinic.home_visits.note: Shared by the Clinic and Nurse editions. Safety timer, SOS, unsafe-abort and address masking are never flags (ADR-025)

nurse.edition.whenOff: No new Nurse sign-ups; existing tenants read-only with export

nurse.individual_tenants.whenOff: Solo plans hidden at sign-up; existing solos keep working

nurse.care_plans.whenOff: Single visits only; active plans complete

nurse.mar.whenOff: Medication recorded as free text in the visit record
nurse.mar.note: MAR allergy/duplicate checks and the doctor-order requirement are never flags (ADR-025)

nurse.individual_kiorex_listing.whenOff: Solo nurses not listed on Kiorex

kiorex.home_visits.whenOff: Home filter hidden; booked home visits honoured
